info.title: RecipePouch Edge API — Repository Replacement
info.description: Repository-scoped replacement contract assembled from implemented Edge Function handlers. It is not a parity reconstruction of the unavailable production OpenAPI v23. The existing handler contract is sourced from current main. Six admin-ai operations freeze the current admin UI types and PR #211 handler contract; they do not assert production deployment parity.

get.description: Requires a valid custom admin session with role owner or admin. The response exposes only apiKeyConfigured, never key material.

post.description: Requires owner or admin. The provider, model mapping, and optional v2 secret envelope are saved atomically. A successful create returns the provider projection. Invalid input or a missing required key returns 400; a transaction conflict returns 409; unavailable v2 key configuration or an unsupported secret operation returns 503.

put.description: Requires owner or admin. An empty apiKey preserves the existing secret reference; an explicit key uses the v2 envelope. Provider metadata edits succeed while referenced. Changing the model returns 409 only when a history or route reference, or a multi-model mapping, prevents the atomic change. An unavailable v2 key configuration returns 503.

delete.description: Requires owner or admin. An unreferenced provider is deleted atomically and returns {ok: true}. History, route, usage, or model references return 409; an unknown provider returns 404.

200.description: Provider and unreferenced models deleted; retained secret rows are not purged

post.description: Requires owner or admin. With providerId, the handler loads the saved provider endpoint, model, and key and ignores caller overrides. Without providerId, name, baseUrl, model, and a one-time apiKey are required. Keys are never persisted or echoed. A saved v1 key is unsupported and returns 409; a provider without a saved key/model also returns 409; a probe failure returns 200 with ok: false.

404.description: 404 not_found: The provider does not exist.

409.description: 409 conflict: the saved provider lacks a usable key/model, its saved key version is unsupported, or a provider model/reference guard rejects a change.

get.description: Requires owner or admin. cachedInputTokens sums reported cache-read input tokens, is null when no event reports a value, and is zero when reported values sum to zero. averageLatencyMs is nullable.

AdminAiBadRequest.description: 400 validation_error: The request body, URL, or usage range is invalid.

AdminAiUnauthorized.description: 401 unauthorized: The custom admin session is missing, invalid, or expired.

AdminAiForbidden.description: 403 forbidden: The session is valid but the role is not owner or admin.

AdminAiNotFound.description: 404 not_found: The provider does not exist.

AdminAiConflict.description: 409 conflict: the saved provider lacks a usable key/model, its saved key version is unsupported, or a provider model/reference guard rejects a change.

AdminAiServiceUnavailable.description: 503 server_misconfigured: the v2 key is unavailable or a required service operation failed. 5xx messages are sanitized.

AdminAiMethodNotAllowed.description: 405 method_not_allowed: The path does not support this HTTP method.

AdminAiInternalError.description: 500 internal_error: An unexpected error occurred; details are not exposed.
